steps.title: The arrow
steps.say: The green arrow shows the demand curve moving to the right, from D1 to D2. It is a shift, not a movement along one curve.

ops.text: Arrow = the whole demand curve shifts right

steps.title: Why right
steps.say: Right means more quantity demanded at every price. Buyers want more, perhaps because incomes rose or the product became popular.

ops.text:
Shift right =
more wanted at
every price

Causes: higher
income, trend,
more buyers

steps.title: Compare
steps.say: At the old price P1, buyers now want more than sellers supply. That shortage pushes the price up to a new equilibrium.

ops.text: Higher demand → price rises from P1 to P2
